features.name: Tenets of Justice
features.description:
**Oath of Justice Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | color spray, guiding bolt |
| 5th | guiding bolt, zone of truth |
| 9th | lightning bolt, slow |
| 13th | faithful hound, locate creature |
| 17th | arcane hand, hold monster |

**Tenets:** Uphold the Law — The law represents the triumph of civilization over the untamed wilds; it must be preserved. Punishment Fits the Crime — The severity of justice acts in equal measure to the severity of a wrongdoer's transgressions.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain two Channel Divinity options:

**Tether of Righteousness.** As an action, extend a line of energy toward a creature within 30 ft. DEX save or it is tethered (can't move more than 30 ft from you for 1 min) and takes lightning damage equal to CHA modifier at the end of each of its turns. As an action, make a STR (Athletics) check vs its STR/DEX to pull it 15 ft toward you. The tethered creature can break free with a STR check vs your spell save DC.

**Justicar's Celerity.** When a creature you can see is attacked, use your reaction to move up to your speed. If you end within 5 ft of the attacker, make one melee attack against it. If you end within 5 ft of the attack's target, become the target instead.

features.name: Disciplined Pursuant
features.description:
At 7th level, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a spell or Divine Smite, you can knock it out (unconscious and stable) instead of killing it.

Once per turn when you deal radiant damage to a creature, you can force a CON save. On failure, its speed is halved until the end of its next turn (only one creature per turn).

features.name: Shackles of Light
features.description: Starting at 15th level, once per turn when you deal radiant damage to a creature, it must make a CON save. On failure, it is restrained by golden spectral chains until the end of its next turn. Only one creature per turn (can be different from Disciplined Pursuant's target).

features.name: Avatar of Perfect Order
features.description:
At 20th level, as an action, become wreathed in cold light for 1 minute:

* Immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
* Use Justicar's Celerity without expending Channel Divinity.
* When a creature takes the Attack or Cast a Spell action, use your reaction to force a WIS save. On failure, it must take a different action of your choice.

1/long rest.

payload.name: Avatar of Perfect Order
payload.description: For 1 min: immune to B/P/S damage; free Justicar's Celerity; reaction to force a creature to change its action (WIS save).
